title: Deep Brain Stimulation for Treatment of Severe Alzheimer's Disease
brief_summary: To investigate the safety of deep brain stimulation in the treatment of severe Alzheimer's disease (AD); to investigate the effectiveness of deep brain stimulation in the treatment of severe AD, i.e., effects of deep brain stimulation on cognitive function in patients with severe AD and dementia grading; to investigate the effects of deep brain stimulation on cerebral glucose metabolism in patients with severe AD.
study_population: Six Patients with severe Alzheimer's disease (AD) scheduled to receive deep brain stimulation will be all recruited from the clinics and wards of Department of Neurosurgery, Chinese PLA General Hospital of China.
